theme: An open day, with the holidays quietly calling.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The day in St. Pete is almost entirely yours — one program at one o'clock, all four girls in the house, and a short stack of travel bookings that have waited long enough.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: Full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, your own note says 'book this week' — overdue since Sep 14. Holiday inventory is thin and sells out; a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist three destinations for the Dec 13–Jan 2 trip with all four girls. The decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have both passed, over the year's thinnest holiday inventory for six.

schedule.title: NACD Program (Portland)
schedule.detail: One hour on the calendar — you're lodged in St. Pete, so likely virtual.

inbox.noise: Everything else is receipts and promos — Amazon, an Apple receipt, Amex offers, Airbnb, plus local sends from St. Pete and Maine.
inbox.clear: No urgent, security, financial, or job-search mail.

recipe.title: Pheasant with Gin and It
recipe.why: Game season is in full swing, and this gin-and-vermouth braise is the kind of unhurried, grown-up cooking that rewards a full house — all four girls under the St. Pete roof this week.
